title: 第26章 基础冥想法（巫师议会第777版）
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
伊森一路看下去，十几种冥想法各有侧重，有的重速度，有的重品质，有的重稳定，有的重后期潜力。

    他的目光最终落在最角落的一枚水晶上。

    那水晶通体透明，内部隐约有淡金色的纹路流转，比其他水晶都要精致些。下方的牌子上写着：

    “基础冥想法（巫师议会第777版）”，巫师议会统一修订的基础冥想法，中正平和，无任何属性偏向。修炼速度上乘，符文品质上乘，精神海稳定性上乘。后期可无伤转换为任何高阶冥想法。

    注：此版本为巫师议会最新修订版，整合了过往七百余版的优化经验，是目前已知最完善的基础冥想法。

    伊森微微挑眉。

    无属性偏向，中正平和，修炼速度和符文品质都是上乘，还能无伤转换高阶冥想法。

    这简直就是完美的选择。

    他转过头，看向那个头发花白的老人。

    “我要这个。”

    老人顺着他的目光看去，浑浊的眼珠转了转，嘴角扯出一个意味不明的弧度。

    “巫师议会第777版？”他慢吞吞地开口，“眼光不错。”

    他走到那枚水晶前，抬手将它取下来，放在柜台上。

    “五十魔石。”

    伊森眉头微皱：“不是二十魔石吗？”

    老人摘下眼镜，不紧不慢地擦了擦镜片，重新戴上。

    “二十魔石是其他冥想法。”他伸出一根枯瘦的手指，点了点那枚透明水晶，“这是巫师议会修订版。议会要收税，懂吗？”

    他顿了顿，像是在回忆什么。

    “这个税嘛，说好听点叫‘知识普及税’。每一枚从议会流出的知识水晶，都要抽成。抽多少？三十魔石。加上学院的成本二十魔石，正好五十。”

    老人抬起眼皮，看着伊森。

    “议会那些大人物定的规矩，我也没办法。爱换不换。”

    五十魔石。

    贵吗？贵。

    但值吗？

    值。

    这冥想法是巫师议会统一修订的最新版，整合了七百多版的优化经验。中正平和，无属性偏向，修炼速度和符文品质都是上乘，最重要的是可以无伤转换高阶冥想法。
content_en:
Ethan looked along and saw that there are more than a dozen meditation methods with different emphasis, some focusing on speed, some focusing on quality, some focusing on stability, and some focusing on late-stage potential.

    His eyes finally landed on a crystal in the far corner.

    The crystal is completely transparent, with faint golden lines flowing inside, making it more delicate than other crystals. The sign below reads:

    "Basic Meditation Method (Wizards' Council Version 777)", the basic meditation method revised by the Wizards' Council, is neutral and peaceful, without any attribute bias. The speed of cultivation is excellent, the quality of the runes is excellent, and the stability of the spiritual sea is excellent. Later, it can be converted to any advanced meditation method without any harm.

    Note: This version is the latest revised version of Wizards Council. It integrates the optimization experience of more than 700 previous versions and is the most complete basic meditation method currently known.

    Ethan raised his eyebrows slightly.

    It has no attribute bias, is neutral and peaceful, has excellent cultivation speed and rune quality, and can also switch to high-level meditation methods without injury.

    This is simply the perfect choice.

    He turned his head and looked at the gray-haired old man.

    "I want this."

    The old man followed his gaze, rolled his cloudy eyes, and curved the corners of his mouth with an unknown meaning.

    "Wizard Council Edition 777?" He said slowly, "Good taste."

    He walked to the crystal, raised his hand, took it off, and placed it on the counter.

    "Fifty magic stones."

    Ethan frowned slightly: "Isn't it twenty magic stones?"

    The old man took off his glasses, wiped the lenses slowly, and put them back on.

    "Twenty magic stones are other meditation methods." He stretched out a skinny finger and tapped the transparent crystal. "This is the revised version of the Wizards' Council. The council has to collect taxes, do you understand?"

    He paused, as if recalling something.

    "This tax is, to put it nicely, a 'knowledge popularization tax'. Every knowledge crystal flowing out of the parliament will be charged a commission. How much? Thirty magic stones. Add the cost of the academy, twenty magic stones, to exactly fifty."

    The old man raised his eyelids and looked at Ethan.

    "I can't help the rules set by the big guys in the council. I can't change them if I like."

    Fifty magic stones.

    Is it expensive? expensive.

    But is it worth it?
